title: Man dies in Garden Hill holding cell
article: A 44-year-old Garden Hill man detained in a holding cell owned and operated by the Garden Hill First Nation Band has suddenly died.

Brian McPherson worked for many years at the Garden Hill Convenience Store and was a "really liked person within the community," the store's manager, Brant Small, said Monday. "He never did anything wrong to anybody," Small said. "He was one of my best employees."
The manager used to have the soft-spoken McPherson watch the store when he was away. "I could always trust him, being alone," he said.
Residents of the community said the holding cell is usually used for intoxicated persons who are released shortly afterward.
Small said McPherson had high blood pressure and died of a heart attack in his cell, but RCMP and the band council did not comment on the case Monday.
McPherson had been placed in the cell by local band constables.
RCMP learned of the death Saturday. The RCMP Island Lake detachment, RCMP major crime services and the Thompson RCMP forensic identification section are investigating.
McPherson was due to work a shift at the convenience store today. "It's a big loss for the store," Small said.
